wallclimb.configuration.title: Wall Climb
wallclimb.configuration.enabled.tooltip: Hold the jump key while facing a wall to climb obstacles up to two blocks tall

wallclimb.configuration.climbSpeed.toolt: Climbing speed in blocks per second; a vanilla ladder is about 4
